occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left alone in a classroom.

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily: This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and found deficient. There is no opportunity during the day for infants to have outdoor time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily (26 TAC §746.2417(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver count in ratio in the infant room did not have a valid background check, The background check was showing as inactive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The fire inspection report continues to be not available for review. Last fire inspection was completed 03/06/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Training requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors-Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: The CPR/First aid training for the director was not available for review.

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During the walk through it was observed that both caregivers in the infant room on their personal device (Cell phone) during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: During the walk through it was observed that there was a bag full of diapers not sealed,hanging from the cabinet.     Note: This was corrected when the bag of opened diapers were thrown away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The fire inspection report was not available for review. Last fire inspection was completed 03/06/24.

Note: The blanket and baby bottle was removed from the crib)
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One out of six personnel files reviewed completed CPR training online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: It was found that the two transporters are missing the transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: The annual training for the director was not available for review.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Four out of six personnel records reviewed is missing the pre-employment form 2912.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the walk through it was found that a child was left unattended in the classroom.     Note: The children were out of room having lunch and the director and caregiver was also out of the room supervising the classroom eating lunch, the child was inside the classroom unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

Note: This was corrected at inspection when this section was added.

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operational policies did not have a section on inclusive care for children.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the policy was added in.

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation the parents were not immediately notified of a child injury that required medical attention. The child stated that they were injured when they fell on a field trip and the director was notified but the parents were not notified until pickup concerning the injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation the incident report was not signed by the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed (26 TAC §746.705)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing mat in the infant room had tears .    Note: This was corrected at inspection when this was replaced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: In the pre-k classroom the exit diagram was missing.     Note: This was posted at inspection and corrected.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One out of seven staff files reivewed had CPR training completed online (National).
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated: The operation administered medication to two children in care without a parent's authorization. The operation no longer administers medications and all parents have been notified of the change in operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated (26 TAC §746.3803(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: 1 out of 4 caregivers  records reviewed did not have the required 24 training hours for the last full year of employment.

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not have the annual training certificatess  to review during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policy was missing the promotional of physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: I did not observe an activity schedule posted in the infant classroom.     NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: a 6 month old was sleeping in a crib that had the mattress propped up by a blanket. Note: A picture was taken. Note: The blanket was removed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))
